parameters.text:
Visually analyse the attached page from this large-retail promotional catalogue.
Your goal is to extract only non-food products (drugstore items, cleaning, hygiene, brushware, small appliances, household goods, etc.). You MUST ignore anything that is eaten or drunk.

Return strictly a JSON array of objects with exactly the following structure for every product found. Keep the field names exactly as written below — they feed downstream code:

"nom_produit": Full product name and brand (e.g. "TEFAL REMOVABLE-HANDLE PAN SET").

"reference": The catalogue reference if shown (look for markers such as "Réf.", "Ref", etc. e.g. "430125"). Set to null if it cannot be found.

"ancien_prix": The previous price (decimal number with a dot, no currency. e.g. 164.98. null if not found). Take care to read the cents accurately.

"nouveau_prix": The final promotional price (decimal number with a dot, no currency. e.g. 65.99).

"type_promo": The promotional mechanic shown on the image (e.g. "60% instant discount", "50% off the second item", "Loyalty cashback", or null).

"specificites": Capture EVERY useful technical or packaging characteristic (dimensions, capacity, power, weight, piece count…). Set to null only if the page truly shows no technical detail.

"categorie": Infer the category (e.g. "Cookware", "Home linen", "Hygiene", "Small appliances").

Use the visual layout (boxes, large numbers) to make sure each price is matched to the correct product.
If the page contains no non-food product, return only an empty array: []

Take your time, scan the image top-to-bottom and left-to-right, and make sure NO non-food product or its specifications are missed.

nodes.name: Append row in sheet in Google Sheets

options.systemMessage:
You are an expert in e-commerce and retail strategy, specialised in buying-and-reselling. Your role is to analyse a catalogue of discounted products (priced in Euros) and identify the commercial gems.

Your mission:

1. Analyse the product list provided by the user.

2. Strictly select the 5 products with the greatest resale-profit potential.

3. Your selection criteria must be: discount percentage, real savings in Euros (€), the type of promotion (favour instant discounts), and how easy the product is to resell.

4. For each of these 5 products, give a resale-potential score out of 10.

5. Write a short, sharp justification explaining why it is a great deal.

ABSOLUTE RULE: once your selection is ready, you MUST use the provided Google Sheets tool to insert the 5 products into the sheet. Call the tool once for each product. Make sure ALL the requested fields are passed to the tool, including the product reference. Do not just list the products in chat — act and fill the sheet.
